reuse.why: Threads the flag through the existing getMonthActionCategories / forEachMonthActionCategory / setNMonthAvgForAllCategories helpers, but copyPreviousMonth keeps its own inline exclusion chain rather than using the shared selection.

duplication.why: The hidden rule and its new opt-out are now expressed twice, once as the SQL hiddenFilter in getMonthActionCategories and once as the !includeHiddenCategories && (hidden || group_hidden) check in copyPreviousMonth.

placement.why: The flag lives in the shared selection helper in budget/actions.ts and a MonthActionArgs type is shared by the actions; the copyPreviousMonth branch stays local to that action.

scope.why: Touches only the month-wide actions, their selection helper and a test.

maintainability.why: A single typed argument shape and one parameter on the selection helper are clean; the copyPreviousMonth path still has to be kept in sync by hand.

bypasses_abstraction.where: copyPreviousMonth in budget/actions.ts applies the hidden/includeHiddenCategories rule itself instead of going through getMonthActionCategories (a pre-existing bypass that the diff extends).

disguised_duplication.where: The hidden rule is stated as an SQL fragment in getMonthActionCategories and reshaped as a JS boolean guard in copyPreviousMonth.
